references.text: Encourages doing good to others, which resembles Jesus' call to love one's enemies.
Urges acts of kindness and compassion, paralleling the command to love and pray for those who persecute you.
Jesus teaches to love enemies and do good to those who hate you, which is in direct agreement with the message in Matthew 5:44.
Paul urges blessing those who persecute, reflecting Jesus' teaching to pray for those who persecute you.
Encourages doing good to all, especially those in the family of faith, which can be seen as an extension of loving one's enemies.
